review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, maintainer decision 2026-09-25, third and fourth passes 2026-09-26: runtime (GUI) translation debt written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: A well is a hit when its score reaches this value. SSMD 3 is a strong effect; 3 for robust z and B-score is three robust standard deviations.
records.source: A well is a hit when its score reaches this value. SSMD 3 is a strong effect; 3 for robust z and B-score is three robust standard deviations.
records.translation: En brunn är en träff när dess poäng når detta värde. SSMD 3 är en stark effekt; 3 för robust z och B-score motsvarar tre robusta standardavvikelser.

records.key: Add the outline micro-SAM drew as one new object: one edit, undone by one Ctrl+Z, written by Save mask and recorded in the field's curation ledger with the prompt, the model and the micro-SAM version. Enter on the image does the same. Default unavailable until an outline is shown.
records.source: Add the outline micro-SAM drew as one new object: one edit, undone by one Ctrl+Z, written by Save mask and recorded in the field's curation ledger with the prompt, the model and the micro-SAM version. Enter on the image does the same. Default unavailable until an outline is shown.
records.translation: Lägg till konturen som micro-SAM ritade som ett nytt objekt: en redigering, ångrad med en Ctrl+Z, skriven av Spara mask och registrerad i bildfältets kureringslogg med prompten, modellen och micro-SAM-versionen. Enter i bilden gör samma sak. Som standard otillgänglig tills en kontur visas.

records.key: Blinded: the source, plates, wells, conditions and file names are hidden, and the crops are in a shuffled order.
records.source: Blinded: the source, plates, wells, conditions and file names are hidden, and the crops are in a shuffled order.
records.translation: Blindat: källan, plattorna, brunnarna, betingelserna och filnamnen är dolda, och utsnitten visas i slumpad ordning.

records.key: Blinded: {count} fields, named by code and in a shuffled order.
records.source: Blinded: {count} fields, named by code and in a shuffled order.
records.translation: Blindat: {count} bildfält, namngivna med kod och i slumpad ordning.

records.key: Click on one object, or drag a box round it, and micro-SAM outlines it. Right-click marks what is not the object. Enter adds the outline as a new object.
records.source: Click on one object, or drag a box round it, and micro-SAM outlines it. Right-click marks what is not the object. Enter adds the outline as a new object.
records.translation: Klicka på ett objekt, eller dra en ruta runt det, så avgränsar micro-SAM det. Högerklick markerar det som inte är objektet. Enter lägger till konturen som ett nytt objekt.

records.key: Confluency {percent} ({source}), {verdict}
records.source: Confluency {percent} ({source}), {verdict}
records.translation: Konfluens {percent} ({source}), {verdict}

records.key: Curate blind: name every field by a code instead of its file name and folder, and show the fields in a shuffled order. The key is kept beside the run journal, outside the data folder. Turning it off unblinds, and the journal records who unblinded and when. Default off.
records.source: Curate blind: name every field by a code instead of its file name and folder, and show the fields in a shuffled order. The key is kept beside the run journal, outside the data folder. Turning it off unblinds, and the journal records who unblinded and when. Default off.
records.translation: Kurera blint: namnge varje bildfält med en kod i stället för dess filnamn och mapp, och visa bildfälten i slumpad ordning. Nyckeln sparas bredvid körjournalen, utanför datamappen. Att stänga av avblindar, och journalen registrerar vem som avblindade och när. Standard av.

records.key: Equalise the histogram inside each tile rather than over the whole field, with a limit on how much any one level may be stretched. It is what brings out objects in a dim corner without saturating the bright middle. It also amplifies noise in empty tiles, which is what the clip limit is for.
records.source: Equalise the histogram inside each tile rather than over the whole field, with a limit on how much any one level may be stretched. It is what brings out objects in a dim corner without saturating the bright middle. It also amplifies noise in empty tiles, which is what the clip limit is for.
records.translation: Utjämna histogrammet inom varje ruta i stället för över hela bildfältet, med en gräns för hur mycket en enskild nivå får sträckas. Det är det som lyfter fram objekt i ett mörkt hörn utan att mätta den ljusa mitten. Det förstärker också brus i tomma rutor, vilket är vad klippgränsen är till för.

records.key: Export the masks as QuPath GeoJSON, an ImageJ RoiSet or COCO JSON, one outline per object with its id and class, or import one of those files back as masks.
records.source: Export the masks as QuPath GeoJSON, an ImageJ RoiSet or COCO JSON, one outline per object with its id and class, or import one of those files back as masks.
records.translation: Exportera maskerna som QuPath-GeoJSON, en ImageJ-RoiSet eller COCO JSON, en kontur per objekt med dess id och klass, eller importera en av dessa filer tillbaka som masker.

records.key: InstanSeg (instanseg-torch 0.1.1) is Apache-2.0, and so are its fluorescence_nuclei_and_cells and brightfield_nuclei models, which InstanSeg downloads itself from the instanseg/instanseg GitHub release (instanseg_models_v0.1.1) into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it.
records.source: InstanSeg (instanseg-torch 0.1.1) is Apache-2.0, and so are its fluorescence_nuclei_and_cells and brightfield_nuclei models, which InstanSeg downloads itself from the instanseg/instanseg GitHub release (instanseg_models_v0.1.1) into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it.
records.translation: InstanSeg (instanseg-torch 0.1.1) är Apache-2.0, liksom dess modeller fluorescence_nuclei_and_cells och brightfield_nuclei, som InstanSeg själv laddar ned från GitHub-releasen instanseg/instanseg (instanseg_models_v0.1.1) till motorns egen mapp. spaCR levererar inget av det.

records.key: InstanSeg, embedding-based segmentation of nuclei and cells that reads any number of fluorescence channels, with its fluorescence_nuclei_and_cells and brightfield_nuclei models or an InstanSeg TorchScript file. A nucleus object keeps its nuclei, every other object its cells. It runs in an environment of its own.
records.source: InstanSeg, embedding-based segmentation of nuclei and cells that reads any number of fluorescence channels, with its fluorescence_nuclei_and_cells and brightfield_nuclei models or an InstanSeg TorchScript file. A nucleus object keeps its nuclei, every other object its cells. It runs in an environment of its own.
records.translation: InstanSeg, inbäddningsbaserad segmentering av kärnor och celler som läser valfritt antal fluorescenskanaler, med sina modeller fluorescence_nuclei_and_cells och brightfield_nuclei eller en InstanSeg-TorchScript-fil. Ett kärnobjekt behåller sina kärnor, alla andra objekt sina celler. Den körs i en egen miljö.

records.key: Locked {sha} at {time}. Runs of these settings on this source are checked against it.
records.source: Locked {sha} at {time}. Runs of these settings on this source are checked against it.
records.translation: Låst {sha} den {time}. Körningar med dessa inställningar på denna källa kontrolleras mot låset.

records.key: Mask generation: segment batches on every GPU allocated to the job
records.source: Mask generation: segment batches on every GPU allocated to the job
records.translation: Maskgenerering: segmentera batcher på varje GPU som tilldelats jobbet

records.key: Needs the {backend} backend, which runs in an environment of its own and is not installed — press Install to install it.
records.source: Needs the {backend} backend, which runs in an environment of its own and is not installed — press Install to install it.
records.translation: Kräver motorn {backend}, som körs i en egen miljö och inte är installerad — tryck på Installera för att installera den.

records.key: Needs two or more compatible CUDA or ROCm GPUs; {count} found on this computer. Cluster Distribution runs use the GPUs allocated to the job.
records.source: Needs two or more compatible CUDA or ROCm GPUs; {count} found on this computer. Cluster Distribution runs use the GPUs allocated to the job.
records.translation: Kräver två eller fler kompatibla CUDA- eller ROCm-GPUs; {count} hittades på den här datorn. Körningar med klusterdistribution använder de GPUs som tilldelats jobbet.

records.key: No analysis lock applies to these settings yet.
records.source: No analysis lock applies to these settings yet.
records.translation: Inget analyslås gäller för dessa inställningar än.

records.key: Nothing was added: under the Overlap rule the outline leaves nothing that is not already an object.
records.source: Nothing was added: under the Overlap rule the outline leaves nothing that is not already an object.
records.translation: Inget lades till: enligt överlappsregeln lämnar konturen inget som inte redan är ett objekt.

records.key: Omnipose is NOT open source: omnipose 1.1.4 carries the Omnipose NonCommercial License (Copyright 2021 University of Washington), which permits use, modification and redistribution for noncommercial purposes only; commercial use needs a licence from UW CoMotion (license@uw.edu). That is not the licence spaCR carries. Its models are downloaded by Omnipose itself from the kevinjohncutler/omnipose-models GitHub repository, which names no licence of its own, into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it. Read the licence before using Omnipose for anything commercial.
records.source: Omnipose is NOT open source: omnipose 1.1.4 carries the Omnipose NonCommercial License (Copyright 2021 University of Washington), which permits use, modification and redistribution for noncommercial purposes only; commercial use needs a licence from UW CoMotion (license@uw.edu). That is not the licence spaCR carries. Its models are downloaded by Omnipose itself from the kevinjohncutler/omnipose-models GitHub repository, which names no licence of its own, into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it. Read the licence before using Omnipose for anything commercial.
records.translation: Omnipose är INTE öppen källkod: omnipose 1.1.4 omfattas av Omnipose NonCommercial License (Copyright 2021 University of Washington), som tillåter användning, ändring och vidaredistribution endast för icke-kommersiella ändamål; kommersiell användning kräver en licens från UW CoMotion (license@uw.edu). Det är inte den licens spaCR har. Dess modeller laddas ned av Omnipose själv från GitHub-arkivet kevinjohncutler/omnipose-models, som inte anger någon egen licens, till motorns egen mapp. spaCR levererar inget av det. Läs licensen innan du använder Omnipose för något kommersiellt.

records.key: Omnipose, for bacteria and other elongated or filamentous cells, with its bact_phase_omni, bact_fluor_omni, worm and cyto2_omni models or an Omnipose checkpoint. It runs in an environment of its own; its masks, flows and distance field come back in Cellpose-SAM's shapes. Noncommercial use only.
records.source: Omnipose, for bacteria and other elongated or filamentous cells, with its bact_phase_omni, bact_fluor_omni, worm and cyto2_omni models or an Omnipose checkpoint. It runs in an environment of its own; its masks, flows and distance field come back in Cellpose-SAM's shapes. Noncommercial use only.
records.translation: Omnipose, för bakterier och andra avlånga eller trådformiga celler, med sina modeller bact_phase_omni, bact_fluor_omni, worm och cyto2_omni eller en Omnipose-kontrollpunkt. Den körs i en egen miljö; dess masker, flöden och avståndsfält kommer tillbaka i Cellpose-SAM:s former. Endast för icke-kommersiell användning.

records.key: Open a folder of images before curating it blind.
records.source: Open a folder of images before curating it blind.
records.translation: Öppna en bildmapp innan du kurerar den blint.

records.key: Open an experiment source before scoring it blind.
records.source: Open an experiment source before scoring it blind.
records.translation: Öppna en experimentkälla innan du poängsätter den blint.

records.key: Pick the control column and the negative control to score hits against.
records.source: Pick the control column and the negative control to score hits against.
records.translation: Välj kontrollkolumnen och den negativa kontroll som träffar ska poängsättas mot.

records.key: Preregister the analysis: freeze these settings, your hypotheses and thresholds, and the model and gate files they name, with a hash and a timestamp, before the results are seen. Every later run on the same source is checked against the lock, and a change is flagged in its manifest, the report and the methods text, as post-hoc once the blinding key has been opened. Default no lock.
records.source: Preregister the analysis: freeze these settings, your hypotheses and thresholds, and the model and gate files they name, with a hash and a timestamp, before the results are seen. Every later run on the same source is checked against the lock, and a change is flagged in its manifest, the report and the methods text, as post-hoc once the blinding key has been opened. Default no lock.
records.translation: Förregistrera analysen: frys dessa inställningar, dina hypoteser och trösklar samt de modell- och grindfiler de nämner, med en hash och en tidsstämpel, innan resultaten har setts. Varje senare körning på samma källa kontrolleras mot låset, och en ändring flaggas i dess manifest, rapporten och metodtexten, som post hoc när blindningsnyckeln har öppnats. Standard inget lås.

records.key: Prompt-based segmentation runs micro-SAM, which is not installed yet.
records.source: Prompt-based segmentation runs micro-SAM, which is not installed yet.
records.translation: Promptbaserad segmentering använder micro-SAM, som inte är installerat än.

records.key: Prompting needs micro-SAM, which is not installed.
records.source: Prompting needs micro-SAM, which is not installed.
records.translation: Prompter kräver micro-SAM, som inte är installerat.

records.key: Prompting off. The objects it added stay in the mask.
records.source: Prompting off. The objects it added stay in the mask.
records.translation: Prompter av. Objekten som lades till ligger kvar i masken.

records.key: Prompting on: click the object, right-click what is not it, or drag a box round it; Enter adds the outline.
records.source: Prompting on: click the object, right-click what is not it, or drag a box round it; Enter adds the outline.
records.translation: Prompter på: klicka på objektet, högerklicka på det som inte är objektet eller dra en ruta runt det; Enter lägger till konturen.

records.key: Put a point on the object, or drag a box round it, before points off it.
records.source: Put a point on the object, or drag a box round it, before points off it.
records.translation: Sätt en punkt på objektet, eller dra en ruta runt det, innan du sätter punkter utanför det.

records.key: Recrop is off while blinded, because the new fields are named after the field they are cut from.
records.source: Recrop is off while blinded, because the new fields are named after the field they are cut from.
records.translation: Nybeskärning är av under blindning, eftersom de nya bildfälten namnges efter bildfältet de skärs ut ur.

records.key: Replace the saved mask of every field that has ROIs in {path}?
records.source: Replace the saved mask of every field that has ROIs in {path}?
records.translation: Ersätta den sparade masken för varje bildfält som har ROIs i {path}?

records.key: Runs through the {backend} backend, which is installed. Use this model writes {prefix}{model} into the object's model setting, which runs that object through {backend} with its usual Mask generation settings.
records.source: Runs through the {backend} backend, which is installed. Use this model writes {prefix}{model} into the object's model setting, which runs that object through {backend} with its usual Mask generation settings.
records.translation: Körs via motorn {backend}, som är installerad. Använd denna modell skriver {prefix}{model} i objektets modellinställning, vilket kör objektet genom {backend} med dess vanliga inställningar för maskgenerering.

records.key: Score blind: hide the source, plates, wells, conditions and file names, and show the crops in a shuffled order. The key is kept beside the run journal, outside the data folder. Turning it off unblinds, and the journal records who unblinded and when. Default off.
records.source: Score blind: hide the source, plates, wells, conditions and file names, and show the crops in a shuffled order. The key is kept beside the run journal, outside the data folder. Turning it off unblinds, and the journal records who unblinded and when. Default off.
records.translation: Poängsätt blint: dölj källan, plattorna, brunnarna, betingelserna och filnamnen, och visa utsnitten i slumpad ordning. Nyckeln sparas bredvid körjournalen, utanför datamappen. Att stänga av avblindar, och journalen registrerar vem som avblindade och när. Standard av.

records.key: Score every well against the negative control and call hits. Needs the negative control picked above and well positions in the table (prc, rowID and columnID, or well).
records.source: Score every well against the negative control and call hits. Needs the negative control picked above and well positions in the table (prc, rowID and columnID, or well).
records.translation: Poängsätt varje brunn mot den negativa kontrollen och bestäm träffar. Kräver den negativa kontroll som valts ovan och brunnspositioner i tabellen (prc, rowID och columnID, eller well).

records.key: Show the area of this field Measure would count as covered by cells, using the Confluency settings of the run.
records.source: Show the area of this field Measure would count as covered by cells, using the Confluency settings of the run.
records.translation: Visa den yta av detta bildfält som Measure skulle räkna som täckt av celler, med körningens konfluensinställningar.

records.key: Show the settings, controls, screens and models built from the future-features list that are not yet released. Off hides them; saved values still reach every run.
records.source: Show the settings, controls, screens and models built from the future-features list that are not yet released. Off hides them; saved values still reach every run.
records.translation: Visa de inställningar, kontroller, skärmar och modeller från listan över framtida funktioner som ännu inte släppts. Av döljer dem; sparade värden når ändå varje körning.

records.key: StarDist 0.9.2 is BSD-3-Clause (Copyright 2018-2025 Uwe Schmidt, Martin Weigert), CSBDeep 0.8.2 BSD-3-Clause and TensorFlow 2.21 Apache-2.0. The pretrained models are downloaded by StarDist itself from the stardist/stardist-models GitHub release (BSD-3-Clause), checked against the digest StarDist pins, into the backend's own folder. spaCR ships none of it.

records.key: StarDist, star-convex polygons for nuclei, with its 2D_versatile_fluo, 2D_versatile_he and 2D_paper_dsb2018 models or a StarDist model folder of your own. It runs on TensorFlow in an environment of its own; its masks and object probability come back in Cellpose-SAM's shapes.
records.source: StarDist, star-convex polygons for nuclei, with its 2D_versatile_fluo, 2D_versatile_he and 2D_paper_dsb2018 models or a StarDist model folder of your own. It runs on TensorFlow in an environment of its own; its masks and object probability come back in Cellpose-SAM's shapes.
records.translation: StarDist, stjärnkonvexa polygoner för kärnor, med sina modeller 2D_versatile_fluo, 2D_versatile_he och 2D_paper_dsb2018 eller en egen StarDist-modellmapp. Den körs på TensorFlow i en egen miljö; dess masker och objektsannolikhet kommer tillbaka i Cellpose-SAM:s former.

records.key: Submits mask_parallel on with a blank mask_gpu_indices, so the job uses exactly the GPUs its scheduler allocates, one model per GPU. Request them in the execution profile, for example --gres=gpu:2. A job given one GPU runs on that one.
records.source: Submits mask_parallel on with a blank mask_gpu_indices, so the job uses exactly the GPUs its scheduler allocates, one model per GPU. Request them in the execution profile, for example --gres=gpu:2. A job given one GPU runs on that one.
records.translation: Skickar mask_parallel på med tomt mask_gpu_indices, så att jobbet använder exakt de GPUs som dess schemaläggare tilldelar, en modell per GPU. Begär dem i körprofilen, till exempel --gres=gpu:2. Ett jobb som får en GPU körs på den.

records.key: The column naming what is in each well. Wells sharing a treatment are replicates and get one replicate SSMD in the export. Leave empty for a screen without replicates.
records.source: The column naming what is in each well. Wells sharing a treatment are replicates and get one replicate SSMD in the export. Leave empty for a screen without replicates.
records.translation: Kolumnen som anger vad som finns i varje brunn. Brunnar som delar en behandling är replikat och får ett gemensamt replikat-SSMD i exporten. Lämna tomt om det inte finns några replikat.

records.key: The file holds several object types. Which one goes on this field?
records.source: The file holds several object types. Which one goes on this field?
records.translation: Filen innehåller flera objekttyper. Vilken ska till detta bildfält?

records.key: The thresholds and gates that decide a call, one per line.
records.source: The thresholds and gates that decide a call, one per line.
records.translation: Trösklarna och grindarna som avgör ett beslut, en per rad.

records.key: Throw away the points, the box and the outline, and start again on another object. Nothing had been added to the mask. Escape on the image does the same. Default unavailable until there is a prompt.
records.source: Throw away the points, the box and the outline, and start again on another object. Nothing had been added to the mask. Escape on the image does the same. Default unavailable until there is a prompt.
records.translation: Kasta punkterna, rutan och konturen och börja om på ett annat objekt. Inget hade lagts till i masken. Escape i bilden gör samma sak. Som standard otillgänglig tills det finns en prompt.

records.key: Turn on hit scoring and name the negative control.
records.source: Turn on hit scoring and name the negative control.
records.translation: Slå på träffpoängsättning och ange den negativa kontrollen.

records.key: Unblinded key {key}; the journal recorded who and when.
records.source: Unblinded key {key}; the journal recorded who and when.
records.translation: Nyckeln {key} avblindad; journalen registrerade vem och när.

records.key: Unblinding shows every field's file name and folder again, and the run journal records who unblinded and when. An analysis lock on this folder treats any later change as post-hoc. Unblind now?
records.source: Unblinding shows every field's file name and folder again, and the run journal records who unblinded and when. An analysis lock on this folder treats any later change as post-hoc. Unblind now?
records.translation: Avblindning visar åter varje bildfälts filnamn och mapp, och körjournalen registrerar vem som avblindade och när. Ett analyslås på denna mapp behandlar varje senare ändring som post hoc. Avblinda nu?

records.key: Unblinding shows where every crop is from again, and the run journal records who unblinded and when. An analysis lock on this folder treats any later change as post-hoc. Unblind now?
records.source: Unblinding shows where every crop is from again, and the run journal records who unblinded and when. An analysis lock on this folder treats any later change as post-hoc. Unblind now?
records.translation: Avblindning visar åter var varje utsnitt kommer ifrån, och körjournalen registrerar vem som avblindade och när. Ett analyslås på denna mapp behandlar varje senare ändring som post hoc. Avblinda nu?

records.key: Used only when mask_parallel is on. {count} GPUs found.
records.source: Used only when mask_parallel is on. {count} GPUs found.
records.translation: Används bara när mask_parallel är på. {count} GPUs hittades.

records.key: Watching: {done} analysed, {waiting} waiting, {failed} failed
records.source: Watching: {done} analysed, {waiting} waiting, {failed} failed

records.key: What the accepted object does where the mask already has an object. Clip keeps only its unlabelled pixels, so no existing object loses a pixel. Skip adds nothing if it touches an existing object. Replace lets it take every pixel it covers, which is how an object a model split into pieces is made one again. Default Clip.
records.source: What the accepted object does where the mask already has an object. Clip keeps only its unlabelled pixels, so no existing object loses a pixel. Skip adds nothing if it touches an existing object. Replace lets it take every pixel it covers, which is how an object a model split into pieces is made one again. Default Clip.
records.translation: Vad det godkända objektet gör där masken redan har ett objekt. Clip behåller bara dess omärkta pixlar, så inget befintligt objekt förlorar en pixel. Skip lägger inte till något om det rör vid ett befintligt objekt. Replace låter det ta varje pixel det täcker, vilket är hur ett objekt som en modell delat i bitar görs till ett igen. Standard Clip.

records.translation: Vad du förväntar dig att hitta, och vad som skulle tala emot det.

records.key: While on, a left click on the image marks the object, a right click marks what is not the object and a left drag draws a box round it. micro-SAM runs in an environment of its own; the first click on a field waits while it embeds the field, and later clicks reuse that embedding. If micro-SAM is not installed, turning this on offers to install it. The Live magnifier is turned off while this is on. Default off.
records.source: While on, a left click on the image marks the object, a right click marks what is not the object and a left drag draws a box round it. micro-SAM runs in an environment of its own; the first click on a field waits while it embeds the field, and later clicks reuse that embedding. If micro-SAM is not installed, turning this on offers to install it. The Live magnifier is turned off while this is on. Default off.
records.translation: När den är på markerar ett vänsterklick i bilden objektet, ett högerklick det som inte är objektet och ett vänsterdrag ritar en ruta runt det. micro-SAM körs i en egen miljö; det första klicket på ett bildfält väntar medan den bäddar in bildfältet, och senare klick återanvänder den inbäddningen. Om micro-SAM inte är installerat erbjuds installation när detta slås på. Liveförstoringsglaset stängs av medan detta är på. Standard av.

records.key: micro-SAM 1.8.14 is MIT (computational-cell-analytics). It builds on Meta's Segment Anything, Apache-2.0. Its light-microscopy model, vit_b_lm ('SAM LM Generalist (ViT-B)', 375 MB), is CC-BY-4.0 on bioimage.io and is downloaded into the backend's own folder the first time a field is prompted. micro-SAM itself is installed without its declared dependencies -- napari, PyQt6, bioimageio.core and trackastra, whose tracking solver pulls in the proprietary gurobipy -- because the prompt path spaCR runs imports none of them.
records.source: micro-SAM 1.8.14 is MIT (computational-cell-analytics). It builds on Meta's Segment Anything, Apache-2.0. records.translation: micro-SAM 1.8.14 är MIT (computational-cell-analytics). Det bygger på Metas Segment Anything, Apache-2.0. Dess ljusmikroskopimodell, vit_b_lm ('SAM LM Generalist (ViT-B)', 375 MB), är CC-BY-4.0 på bioimage.io och laddas ned till motorns egen mapp första gången ett bildfält promptas. micro-SAM själv installeras utan sina deklarerade beroenden -- napari, PyQt6, bioimageio.core och trackastra, vars spårningslösare drar in det proprietära gurobipy -- eftersom promptvägen som spaCR kör inte importerar något av dem.

records.key: micro-SAM, Segment Anything fine-tuned for microscopy, for prompt-based segmentation in Make Masks: click points on one object, or drag a box round it, and it returns that object's mask. Each field is embedded once and every later click on it is answered from the cached embedding.

records.translation: micro-SAM, Segment Anything finjusterad för mikroskopi, för promptbaserad segmentering i Make Masks: klicka punkter på ett objekt, eller dra en ruta runt det, så returnerar den objektets mask. Varje bildfält bäddas in en gång och varje senare klick på det besvaras från den cachade inbäddningen.
